title: Weight review toward weak skills
statement: Weight spaced review toward the skills learners are weakest on, giving them at least half of it, interleaved with the rest.
example: One Grade 3 course found its spaced review under-weighted weak skills and reweighted it to at least 50% weak-skill items, interleaved.
detail: A Grade 3 reading course's handoff lists among its verified fixes that spaced review under-weighted weak skills; it was reweighted to at least 50% weak-skill items, interleaved, and an extra lesson on one standard (RI.3.9) was added. The one-shot script that made the change is listed with the same 50% figure. No effect on learning was measured: this is a recorded design fix, not a tested one.

evidence.quote: - **Spaced review under-weighted weak skills** → reweighted ≥50% weak-skill, interleaved; extra RI.3.9 lesson added.
